turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: Hey Sam! It's been way too long. How was the move? Did you finally get out of the old apartment?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: We did! Last box went in the truck Sunday. The new place has actual closet space, which after five years feels like winning the lottery.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: Ha, that's the dream. How's the neighborhood? Any good coffee within walking distance?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: There's a little roaster two blocks down that does a ridiculous cortado. You'd love it. We should go when you're in town.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: I'm holding you to that. Actually I might be over your way in September for my cousin's wedding.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Oh nice, September's gorgeous here. Let me know the dates and I'll keep that weekend open.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: Will do. How's the new job treating you? Last time we talked you were still deciding whether to take it.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I took it, and so far no regrets. The team's kind, the work is interesting, and my commute is a ten-minute bike ride now.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: A ten-minute bike commute? Okay now I'm jealous. Mine is still an hour each way on a good day.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: You should come visit and remember what fresh air feels like. Seriously though, how are you doing? How's everything with your dad?

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: He's doing a lot better, thanks for asking. The physical therapy is slow but he's back to gardening, which is basically his whole personality.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: That's such good news. Tell him the tomato guy from the barbecue says hi.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: He will absolutely remember you as the tomato guy. Alright, I should let you get back to unpacking. Send me those September dates.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I will. Text me when you book the flights. So good to catch up, Jordan.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: You too. Enjoy the new place, and go get me one of those cortados. Talk soon!
